hook.name: ReactorV4
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 ERC-20 hook token (REACTOR) that charges a 2% buy and 3% sell tax in ETH to a shared "jar." Holders accrue "honey" proportional to token balance and time held; when a "strength" buffer drains to zero from net sell pressure, the jar splits among non-selling holders by honey weight. Sellers forfeit their honey accrual for that round.
